result.summary: The page is mostly visually intact, but there is one noticeable content truncation issue in the horizontal restaurant list.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Picco' in the 'Fastest near you' horizontal card list is truncated/cut off at the right edge, making the full name unreadable.
issues.suggestion: Apply text ellipsis (e.g., 'Trattoria Picco...') or wrap the text within the card bounds so the truncation is graceful and the user can still identify the venue.

issues.description: The bottom pizza card in the 'Popular right now' section is partially cut off, with no visible scroll affordance to indicate more content below the fold.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the last visible card is clipped cleanly and consider adding a subtle indicator, or let the card peek further to signal vertical scrolling.
